latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Face Swap — easily swap faces in any video using cloud GPU processing.

- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM video files up to 500MB; outputs 1080p MP4.
- Simple upload and face replacement workflow for creators, filmmakers, and social media users.
- Anonymous access with 7-day free credits if no API token is set.
- Handles uploads, exports, status checks, and session management automatically.
- Provides helpful messages for errors like unsupported formats, missing credits, or large files.
